card.name: Word-start pieces in drug and heading text
card.fires_on: Short word-start or capitalized pieces at the start of a drug name, heading or brand name, such as did, Is, I, D, One or TS. Seen in label headings, contraindication lists and table titles.

modes.label: Drug name starts
modes.description: The first piece of a drug or brand name that is split into parts.

modes.label: Capital letters in headings
modes.description: A lone capital letter or short capitalized piece opening a heading or list item.

card.plain: It fires on the first fragment of a split-up drug name or heading, and does not carry a clear meaning.
